item.title: Welcome new Little Star Weekly curator, Jason Stopa!

item.title: Tim Parks reinvents literary criticism
item.description: At Little Star we consider Tim Parks one of the central writers of the age. His novels—Europa, for instance, and Destiny and Cleaver—forge new literary constructions around narrators who are, on the one hand, intelligent and controlling and, on the other, unstable, revelatory, and self-discovering. His criticism for The New York Review of Books and […]

item.title: Finally! Selected Poems of Melissa Green
item.description: It’s a celebratory week for Little Star because at long last the work of our beloved contributing editor Melissa Green becomes available in a new selected poems from Boston’s adventurous Arrowsmith Press. item.title: Ingrid Winterbach in Little Star
item.description: This week in Little Star Weekly we return to the rich, various, demanding work of South African novelist Ingrid Winterbach, published on these shores by the intrepid Open Letter Books.
